name: recipe_scale
description: Scale a recipe's ingredient list by servings, by a factor or to a target amount of one ingredient, in exact fractions: reads quantities like 1 1/2, ½, 2-3 and units (cups, tbsp, tsp, fl oz, g, kg, oz, lb, ml, l, pinches, cans), gives the exact scaled amount and a measurable one (cups to 1/4 or 1/3, tbsp to 1/2, tsp to 1/8, grams whole), moves small cup amounts to spoons and flags fractional eggs.

ingredients.description: Lines such as "1 1/2 cups flour" or objects {quantity, unit, name}

unit.description: Default: the recipe's unit for that ingredient

convert_units.description: Move small cup amounts to tbsp, 3 tsp to 1 tbsp, quarter cups of tbsp to cups

catalog.source: original; US customary kitchen measures (1 cup = 16 tbsp = 48 tsp) and mass units from NIST Handbook 44 App. C
